span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Spatial firing arises because location happens to be a continuous task-relevant variable, not because physical space is privileged for this circuit
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Performing a task drives a sequence of firing fields that are elicited parametrically as behaviour progresses
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Overlap between neighbouring fields encodes the order and adjacency of behavioural states, supporting episodic linking and planning
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: traversal speed is randomised trial by trial so that sound frequency and elapsed time are uncoupled, which is what makes a frequency field distinguishable from a time field
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: a model tested the strength of alignment of the neural activity to various task events, and each field was found to align best either to particular sound frequencies or to the press or the release of the joystick
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the proposed general mechanism is that task performance activates a progression of firing fields, so that neighbouring and overlapping fields represent the order and adjacency of behavioural states
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the absence of field broadening across the trial is attributed to an informative sensory variable being continuously available, unlike in a delay task where the code can drift
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Too few fields per grid cell in the sound task to test whether its firing corresponds to a one-dimensional slice through a hexagonal grid lattice.
span.note: what this limits: the hexagonal-lattice interpretation only: THE SMALL NUMBER OF FIELDS PRODUCED BY GRID CELLS in the sound task makes the 1-dimensional-slice reading untestable here
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The task itself did not require the animals to represent the whole acoustic dimension, so the functional necessity of the representation is not established.
span.note: what this limits: every functional claim about the acoustic representation: IN THE SMT, RATS DID NOT ACTUALLY NEED TO REPRESENT THE STRUCTURE OF THE ENTIRE ACOUSTIC SPACE - the representation is not necessary for the behaviour
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Grid-cell yield depended on arena size, fewer being detected in the smaller environment.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison of grid-cell yield between environments: Quotation withheld THAN IN THE LARGER ONE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The three alignment classes (press-, release-, frequency-aligned) were not cleanly separable, with some fields loading on more than one task parameter.
span.note: what this limits: the three-way classification of firing fields: THE THREE CLUSTERS WERE NOT PERFECTLY SEPARATED ... SOME FIRING FIELDS HAD SIGNIFICANTLY NON-ZERO REGRESSION COEFFICIENTS FOR MORE THAN ONE TASK PARAMETER: 14% IN CA1 - the classes overlap, and by how much is measured
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the hexagonal-lattice reading of the grid cell results could not be tested, because grid cells produced too few fields in this task
span.note: what this limits: the same scope as item 0 - too few fields to test the lattice reading

span.label: RETRACTED (A HEDGED RESEMBLANCE BETWEEN TWO SETS OF FIRING FIELDS, RENDERED AS `firing field --same-as--> navigation`) · firing field —same-as→ navigation
span.note: RETRACTED: A HEDGED RESEMBLANCE BETWEEN TWO SETS OF FIRING FIELDS, RENDERED AS `firing field --same-as--> navigation`. The span: activity 'was largely confined to discrete firing fields ( Fig. 2a ) AKIN TO THOSE OBSERVED DURING SPATIAL NAVIGATION'. THE AUTHOR DECLINES THE IDENTITY IN THE SAME BREATH, and the tag is stronger than the sentence it quotes. AND THE ENDPOINTS DO NOT SURVIVE READING ALOUD: a firing field is not the same thing as navigation, and the edge as written asserts that it is. What the sentence relates is firing fields IN THIS TASK to firing fields IN NAVIGATION - the same term on both sides, distinguished by task, which the two-endpoint form cannot express. Already carried by [39] and its unhoused row. — strength of the relation: 1 — discrete fields akin to those observed during spatial navigation, clustered at trial boundaries but spanning the whole task
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: RETRACTED (A CO-OCCURRENCE READ AS A CAUSE, WITH THE DIRECTION REVERSED) · firing field —causes→ press
span.note: RETRACTED: A CO-OCCURRENCE READ AS A CAUSE, WITH THE DIRECTION REVERSED. The edge is `firing field --causes--> press`. The span: 'Across the population, Quotation withheld; Fig. 2b). However, they spanned the entire task, occurring both during and outside of the sound presentation period.' `Clustered at` and `near` are statements of WHERE the fields are, not of what produces what - and the joystick press is THE ANIMAL'S ACTION, so if either direction were asserted it would be the press that organises the firing, not the firing that causes the press. THE SENTENCE AFTER IT WEAKENS THE EDGE FURTHER: the fields 'spanned the entire task', which is the authors saying the clustering is a tendency and not a confinement. FOUND BY THE NEIGHBOUR QUERY (Q-400): it sits on the same span as [52], retracted earlier today for reading `akin to` as an identity - one hedged sentence, two different faults, and I had read that span twice without seeing this one. Q-402. — strength of the relation: 1

span.note: RETRACTED: SAME PAPER, SAME FAULT, AND HERE THE DROPPED TERM IS NAMED IN THE SPAN. The edge is `frequency --same-as--> navigation`. The span: cells fired around consistent sound frequency values 'forming “frequency fields” ANALOGOUS TO PLACE FIELDS in spatial navigation.' THE AUTHOR DECLINES THE IDENTITY IN THE SAME BREATH, and the tag is stronger than the sentence it quotes. The analogy the sentence draws is FREQUENCY FIELDS to PLACE FIELDS - both named, both compound - and the edge keeps `frequency` and `navigation`, which are the two halves that were NOT being compared. Reading it back: 'frequency is the same as navigation'. Already carried by [39] and its unhoused row. — strength of the relation: 1 — AND THE NEW THING IS NAMED AFTER THE OLD ONE - frequency fields called analogous to place fields - in the very sentence that shows the old name was too narrow
